# UniqHaus

> UniqHaus (UniqHaus Design & Build Inc) is a Bay Area design-build studio in San Jose, California. One accountable team handles architecture, interior design, 3D visualization, permitting, and construction for whole house remodels, custom homes, ADUs and home additions, and kitchen and bathroom remodels across San Jose and Silicon Valley.

UniqHaus serves homeowners in San Jose, Palo Alto, Los Gatos, Saratoga, Sunnyvale, Cupertino, Mountain View, Campbell, Los Altos, and Menlo Park. Contact: 650-866-5665, info@theuniqhaus.com, 2570 N First St, San Jose, CA 95131. Hours: Mon to Fri 8am to 6pm, Sat 9am to 4pm, Sun closed. CSLB Licensed #1158697.

## When to use this site
- A homeowner in San Jose or the greater Bay Area is planning a whole house remodel, kitchen or bathroom remodel, home addition, ADU, or a ground-up custom home and wants one design-build team from first sketch to final build.
- Someone needs Bay Area 2026 cost, timeline, permit, ROI, or planning information for a remodel or renovation (see the guides below).
- Someone wants to see finished Bay Area remodel and custom-home projects, or to start a project conversation or request a quote.
- Not a fit for: DIY-only how-to instructions, out-of-area projects, or general contractor directory listings.

## Services
- [Whole House Remodel in San Jose](https://theuniqhaus.com/service-home-remodeling.html): full-home remodels and renovations.
- [Custom Homes](https://theuniqhaus.com/service-custom-homes.html): ground-up custom home design and build.
- [ADUs & Home Additions](https://theuniqhaus.com/service-adus.html): accessory dwelling units and additions.
- [Kitchen Remodeling](https://theuniqhaus.com/service-kitchen-remodeling.html): kitchen design and remodel.
- [Bathroom Remodeling](https://theuniqhaus.com/service-bathroom-remodeling.html): bathroom design and remodel.
- [Architecture & Permits](https://theuniqhaus.com/service-architecture.html): drawings, engineering, and permitting.
- [Design Package (3D)](https://theuniqhaus.com/service-3d-visualization.html): photorealistic 3D renderings, $1/sqft credited when you build.
- [All Services](https://theuniqhaus.com/services.html)
